_instructions: Each entry tests the /chat endpoint in one language. 'reference_response' should be filled in by a native/fluent speaker on your team with a short example of an appropriate, supportive reply to the 'message' below (in that language). The benchmark script computes semantic similarity between the chatbot's actual reply and this reference using a multilingual sentence embedding model. If you leave 'reference_response' empty, semantic-similarity scoring is skipped for that language but latency and language-detection accuracy are still measured.
